notes: Strip e: x 6320-7860 plus ~300 px overlap (6020-8160). Reading Road crossings west of x~6020 (Union, Bowman Terrace, Melish, Lincoln, Tennis Lane, Oak, June at x~5800-5960) are left to strip d. Union Street east of Reading is printed only 'ST.'; named Union because its 610-640 numbers continue Union's 500s west of Reading (Union jogs ~45 px north across Reading). Savoy printed SAVOY and ST.; Concordia printed CONCORDIA, ST.; Viola printed VIOLA, ST.; Bowman Avenue printed BOWMAN ... AVE. (distinct from Bowman Terrace, the dead-end U lane off Reading). Winslow Avenue: AVENUE printed near Tennis Lane and WINSLOW south of Crown; assumed one street (continuous straight line from Lincoln to McMillan). Tennis Lane: TENNIS printed west of Viola, LANE east of Winslow, same straight 20-ft lane. Arndt Alley: ARNDT printed west of Winslow; the alley east of Winslow (to May) printed only ALLEY and jogs ~50 px south; named Arndt by assumption. Hinman Street is 30 ft and runs only from Lincoln (at the viaduct ramp) to Tuxedo Place. Four stubs south of McMillan Street are cut by the plate edge with partial labels ('...UIS', '...NE', '...TON', '...CORD ST.'); named '?'. Streets on this plate are drawn slightly rotated: E-W streets rise ~4 px per 100 px eastward and N-S streets (May, Stanton) drift east southward. A 12-ft alley stub leaves Reading Road eastward at about (6500, 455) at the plate edge (not picked). Unnamed 20-ft alley between Concordia and Bathgate at y~2815 not picked.
